reviews.text: My pug Moose had worms and I was about to make an appt the next day. They take into consideration what you can afford and don't press you to get things you don't need or cannot afford right away. Dr's are kind and gentle w me pets. Usually not a long wait time. Moose was patiently waiting to be seen.

My pups have all been seen by Dr. Beisnner since he was at the St. Cloud location.
Needless to say, the Dr. and his staff are all so professional and caring.  I would recommend Blue Cross Pet Clinic to anyone who wants a safe and kindhearted experience.
I'm new to this clinic and wish I'd known of them sooner. The Dr. And staff are very compassionate,  friendly and professional.  This place is The Best. Great experience for me and out cat.

Came here with a puppy that needed its ears to treated, stitches removed and cleaned out, I was a min late (yes I was wrong!) I called ahead and they stated within 5mins I pulled up within the time frame and they turned me and my puppy away, what vet that suppose to care about animals turns a puppy away in need of help!? Would not recommend! I’ll take my money else where! I recommend you do the same if they are willing to turn a sick animal away!
Fast and excellent  service
Amazing staff, very clean. We’ve been bringing our dogs here for years & will continue to do so.

I was so nervous leading up to my dog’s dental cleaning appointment but it couldn’t have gone any smoother! I appreciated all of the communication between me and all members of the staff. The discharge instructions were clear and easy to understand. Thank you so much for taking great care of my baby!
Love the facility and employees Dr was wonderful and Desiree was awesome true customer service would recommend. MY Tech was awesome.

My appointment for my cat Stella was at 4:00, I was asked to show up 15 minutes early, so I did. The Doctor came in at 4:42.I was given a choice to take my cat else where for treatment or have them give her the same treatment she was given before that didn't work I thought maybe it would be better to take Stella elsewhere. So they charged me 75.00 for, I felt for the time I spent in the room. I will not be going back.
Charla, thank you for the 5-star! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🥰 🐾 …
Everyone at the office was very kind and helpful
These people never answer the phone
Care was very good.  Doctors and staff very professional and caring.
Dr. Plouffe and Amanda were attentive, kind, and very informative. Thank you for seeing my little Kevin. I’m glad Chris from the front was able to schedule me for that same day, thank you.
The veterinarian, Dr Cousins and the patient assistant, Cat, were wonderful.
Excellent with my furbabies
My dog's and I are very happy with this team of doctors, technicians, pharmacist and administrative staff! They are all very professional, friendly and make us feel like family.
Jon, thank you for your support! We truly appreciate you choosing and trusting our team with your pet’s care. 🐾 😍 …

Holy Matrimony 👠🥊🌴
I love visiting our well equiped Vet .
We love you 💕
GODESS LOVE 🙏🏼💋
I have been going to Blue Cross Pet Clinic for over 30 years and have always received great service from all the staff.  I would highly recommend them to anyone.
Staff and vets are professional and courteous. They do get busy, but that just indicates that a lot of people use them. The app they use is quick and easy to make appointments and get refills.
Vets and techs are very kind and professional
Excellent explanations frim the vet
Very nice
Jose, thank you so much for the support. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

I have been taking my dogs Kramer and Charlie girl to blue cross for years and have loved the way they have loved and treated my dogs.  Recently, Charlie girl crossed 🌈 and they were very sympathetic and gave me the time I needed and didn’t rush my final moments with my girl.😞❤️🙏. Today 9-17-2024 they sent me a card with everyone signing it which made my day and will be forever thankful for their kindness.  The card was a pleasant surprise
Thank you guys for everything ❤️
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Abraham. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
Missed Dr. B, but Doctor Cousins is awesome! Thanks to Patrick for the help with our dogs!

Clifford had a Dr. Appointment for deworming and flea and tick meds. Izzy the nurse was awesome. He enjoyed all the petting and kind words.  Dad's been going there for years with his prior fur babies. But this was moms first time and she was impressed. Very nice environment.

Cat was wonderful with our baby Daisy.
She was loving and explained everything clearly.
